plan_point: 77.44 / WEB-011 -> 77.44.7.D / D-06; EDT-037 keyboard Layers selection feeding EDT-038 clipboard
scope: Keeps focus in the Layers tree after pointer selection rerenders rows, enabling immediate Shift+Arrow range selection followed by the existing keyboard clipboard flow. A selected sibling range is copied and pasted as nested node trees, remains draft-only until Save, and is one undo/redo operation. This is a bounded EDT-037/EDT-038 slice and does not certify either full item or the Editor.

runtime.summary: After a Layers row click updates selection and rerenders, restore focus to the replacement row. Selection commands used by keyboard and canvas paths preserve their existing rendering behavior.

keyboard paste remains local until explicit Save
single Undo removes and Redo restores the range paste
the existing multi-root pointer clipboard, Save/reload, separate Publish, and mobile paste lifecycle remains covered
